title: SealedPayloadEnvelope v1 — one sensitive task payload sealed to its executing node: the header (task id, kind, both ends, the ephemeral X25519 public key, and the nonce) travels in the clear as metadata and is covered by the MAC; the content travels only as ciphertext (hex) whose length matches the canonical-JSON plaintext, authenticated by an HMAC-SHA256 mac over header and ciphertext under a key only the recipient's private sealing key can derive — no plaintext, no payload hash, and no key material ever appears in an envelope (Y-070)
